snippet.title: Battleborn: Toby's Friendship Raid
snippet.description:
GET BERG BACK! Join Toby in saving his stolen mech suit from greedy LLC hands. The second DLC Story Operation, "Toby's Friendship Raid," is available now in #Battleborn.

Each Story Operation expands on the Battleborn universe and drops you right into the middle of the action. Story Operations are available as part of the Season Pass and Digital Deluxe edition, or can be purchased through the in-game Marketplace. 

Command 29 unique heroes and save the universe from the brink of extinction! Fight alone or alongside friends, play story missions or mow down foes in competitive multiplayer matches.  

From the creators of Borderlands comes Battleborn, a new first-person shooter for every kind of badass available on May 3, 2016 for the PlayStation 4, PC, and Xbox One. 

Battleborn is rated T for TEEN (Language, Violence). For more information about Battleborn, visit http://battleborn.com.
